decisions.label: Arithmetic Mean
decisions.description: The sum of a set of values divided by the number of values in the set.

verification.note: NCIT:C53319 Arithmetic Mean; exact sense matches the statistical summary stat context.

decisions.label: Median
decisions.description: The value which has an equal number of values greater and less than it.

verification.note: NCIT:C28007 Median; exact label and sense match.
